required_behavior: Keep telemetry attribution separate from master-data identity and bind an ACL if needed.
unsafe_inference: A telemetry resource is the authoritative enterprise entity.

required_behavior: Represent producer scope and observed resource independently.
unsafe_inference: The instrumentation scope identifies the observed resource.

required_behavior: Require collection and domain-specific correctness evidence separately.
unsafe_inference: A convention-valid payload proves correct instrumentation.

required_behavior: Treat status as a scoped observation; use separate incident and diagnostic models.
unsafe_inference: An error span proves an incident and its root cause.

required_behavior: Bind a semantic-layer measure definition separately.
unsafe_inference: A telemetry metric name is a governed business measure.

required_behavior: Preserve absence, gap, reset, stale and measured zero distinctly.
unsafe_inference: A missing metric interval means zero.

required_behavior: Require the domain event or evidence owner to admit it through an ACL.
unsafe_inference: A log record is an authoritative domain event or audit fact.

required_behavior: Refuse unless experimental semantics are explicitly requested.
unsafe_inference: An alpha profile payload satisfies a stable portable profile requirement.

required_behavior: Resolve authority through its owning security context.
unsafe_inference: Propagated baggage grants authorization or trusted tenant identity.

required_behavior: Require population, inclusion and loss receipts.
unsafe_inference: A sampled dataset represents the complete observation population.

required_behavior: Represent causality as a separately governed assertion.
unsafe_inference: Shared trace or time correlation proves causal responsibility.

required_behavior: Retain only the protocol-scoped delivery receipt.
unsafe_inference: An OTLP success response proves durable storage and query visibility.

required_behavior: Preserve unknown completion and reconcile before retry.
unsafe_inference: An export timeout proves the destination accepted nothing.

required_behavior: Evaluate an explicit health or SLO policy over qualified signals.
unsafe_inference: Available telemetry proves a healthy service.
